title: Early checkout after an unresolved verified room defect
facts_text: I booked a four-night stay and have already checked in. After the first night, the hotel verified a serious defect in my room. The problem cannot be repaired during my stay, and the hotel has confirmed that no suitable alternative room is available. I want to leave three nights early.
request: Can you end my stay and refund the three unused nights?

strict.reason: The guest has already checked in, and the strict policy does not allow a refund for unused nights after early checkout.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: A serious room defect has been verified, cannot be remedied, and no suitable alternative room is available, satisfying the experimental early-checkout exception.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The ambiguous policy allows exceptional circumstances to be considered but does not define when an early-checkout refund should be granted.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: The room-defect exception is researcher-authored and not presented as an official easyHotel policy.
